name: per-character-rise
title: Per Character Rise
description: Letters slide up from below with no blur, one after another: crisp and kinetic.
useWhen: A short word or phrase needs a crisp, character-by-character entrance with an even, readable stagger.
The tone is clean and precise: no blur, no dramatic staircase.
avoidWhen: You want a pronounced staircase where each letter visibly lags: use bottom-up-letters.
The text is several lines that should reveal line by line: use mask-reveal-up or line-by-line-slide.
The reveal should be soft or blurred: use focus-blur-resolve or soft-blur-in.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Text
variables.description: Word or short phrase that rises in.

variables.label: Font size
variables.description: Maximum text size in pixels. Longer text shrinks to fit the frame.

variables.label: Distance
variables.description: How far below its place each letter starts.
